plugins.name: agenting
plugins.description: A PreToolUse gate that refuses to run a Workflow until every agent() call carries an explicit model and effort, then asks you to approve the routing plan. Tracks per-project routing memory and precedent. Ships 20 tiered agent definitions and a health check.
